method: DSM minus DTM sampled at 0.5 m pixel centers inside official UrbIS building footprints
blocking_reason: The previously generated evidence was semantically degenerate: sampled terrain elevations and DSM-DTM building heights were repeatedly 0.0 m while confidence was reported as high. Archive hashes, dimensions and alignment alone are therefore not sufficient proof of usable elevation values.

invalidated_outputs.trust_policy: Do not use these former confidence counts or heights for runtime, realism claims, terrain, LOD, or integration.

next_action: Re-run official DSM/DTM extraction through the new semantic mosaic quality gate, inspect source raster value distributions and sidecar interpretation, then publish replacement per-building evidence only if the gate passes.
